column1: # W56: decompose the multi-step AWC/NCR gain between its two passes, plus a
# retirement-dose contrast.
# WHY. tab:ablation-main's checkmark ladder turns BOTH NCR passes on together
# on multi-step, while Sec 4.5(2) claims each pass serves its own budget
# geometry. No archived arm ever ran one pass alone (grep over all job TSVs:
# zero rows with CRS=1 and CRS_NESTED unset/0 on omnigui/mind2web). The
# operators gate on independent flags (crs_enabled vs crs_nested_enabled;
# geopact_vl_hook.py L2993 checks only the nested flag), so single-pass twins
# are well defined.
# ANCHORS. The W55-verified true tight-budget anchors: cur_only flips only
# GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED to 0, ret_only flips only GEOPACT_CRS to 0. Adopted
# references for reading deltas: OmniGUI a2cap_c25_h05 (GP 24.04, EM 43.08),
# M2W a6nocov_c25_h05 pooled Step SR 34.20; the no-AWC rung of the ladder is
# DOSE. nested_frac10/20 vary only GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED_FRAC against the OmniGUI
# anchor's adopted 0.05, giving a three-point retirement dose response to
# mirror the current-frame curve in fig:dose.
# BENCHMARK|TASK|TRACK|EXP_ARM|RATIO|HIST_N|OUT|LIMIT|EXTRA_ENV
